147-3085-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-8095.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-6255--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7705-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-7705-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-3055-6553.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4247-4871-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
4247-4871-5220-5447.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

240-647-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-647-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7640.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

224-2157-4826-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Mutavault land token due to Archelos.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-1753-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-1753-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3094-4659-5390-6968-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5390-6968-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

628-4050-7217.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

3967-4605-6132-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

465-3967-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

851-2919-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-2919-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

575-4050-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Repeat from step 5.

1418-1651-1863-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-1863-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-1863-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

774-2232-6763.notablePrerequisites: You have two nonartifact land cards in hand, at least one of which can tap to produce mana.
774-2232-6763.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two nonartifact lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the lands enter, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-2292-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2292-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

339-677-969-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin

602-6574.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in your hand that is greater than your maximum hand size.
602-6574.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Kefka triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 as needed for all remaining Feast of Sanity triggers.
Once all players have passed priority and the stack is empty, you will still be in your cleanup step, and will discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3562-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

2640-4050-4336-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {W}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2351-3642-4639.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Hair-Strung Koto by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Hair-Strung Koto ability.
Repeat.

222-527-2079-2438.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2079-2438.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1912-4499-4716.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Prosperous Innkeeper.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

333-4050-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4050-5617.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos, adding one mana of any color.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Repeat.

215-2792-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}.
215-2792-5778.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2947-4881-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Activated Sleeper's power.
Repeat from step 3.

780-3277-4050.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Izzet Chronarch.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, adding {B}.
When Izzet Chronarch dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
